gloss: to slip into; to sneak into; to steal into

definitions.gloss: to slip into; to sneak into; to steal into
definitions.explanation: To enter a place stealthily, often by passing through an opening or gap. Combines the idea of slipping through (抜ける) with entering deeply (込む).

examples.japanese: ⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{抜|ぬ}け{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I slipped in through the back entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{垣根|かきね}→垣根：00149_kakine⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抜|ぬ}け{込|こ}ん⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A cat sneaked into the garden through a gap in the hedge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かいくぐって⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抜|ぬ}け{込|こ}む⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to sneak into the building while evading the guards.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to slip through, to pass through) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to go into, to enter deeply). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ auxiliary adds the sense of entering or penetrating into a space. Intransitive verb -- the subject moves stealthily into a place.

TRANSITIVITY: intransitive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{抜|ぬ}け{込|こ}む: to slip in through the back door
- ⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧{抜|ぬ}け{込|こ}む: to sneak in secretly
- ⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{抜|ぬ}け{込|こ}む: to slip in through a gap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忍|しの}び{込|こ}む→忍び込む：12578_shinobikomu⟧: to sneak in -- emphasizes stealth and secrecy more strongly
- ⟦{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む→潜り込む：15190_mogurikomu⟧: to sneak/burrow into -- emphasizes hiding or going under cover
- ⟦{入|はい}り{込|こ}む→入り込む：04629_hairikomu⟧: to enter, to get into -- more neutral, without the stealth nuance
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧: to slip out -- the opposite direction, escaping from a place
